name: operators
description: Each operator against every JSON type: a match, a miss and wrongly typed values (a number where a string is expected, "18" for gt, "1.2" for semverGt, the number 1 for in ["1"], true for in [1], arrays and objects). Values compare strictly by type; a clause on a value of the wrong type doesn't match; notIn matches any present value not in the list.
